labels: Back on the wall, heels out

text.setup: Lean your back against a wall with your heels about a foot out in front of you, legs straight.
cues: Pull your toes up towards your shins as far as they go, heels staying down.
Pause at the top and squeeze the front of your shins.
Lower slowly until the toes just touch, then go again.
mistakes: Bouncing the toes off the floor.
Bending the knees to cheat the range.

variants.plate: A tib bar or a plate strapped over your toes; sit on a bench with your heels at the edge.
variants.dumbbells: Sit on a bench and hold a light dumbbell between your feet.
variants.kettlebell: Sit on a bench and hook a light kettlebell over your toes.
variants.machine: Sit with the pad over the top of your feet and lift the toes against it.
variants.resistance_band: Sit with legs out, the band round the top of your feet and anchored in front.
